checklist.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for EDGE-RECV-TO-CHECK: P2P block data request input validation
checklist.risk_category: Denial of Service / Remote Code Execution
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Send malformed P2P block data requests with non-numeric block number fields (strings, negative values, floats, excessively large integers). 2. Send requests with block numbers encoded in unexpected formats (hex without 0x prefix, leading zeros). 3. Verify the eth/70 handler at the devp2p interface rejects all malformed inputs before any further processing. 4. Confirm no partial parsing or type coercion occurs on untrusted block number data from EXT-P2P-PEER-ETH70.
executable_checks: Fuzz block number field with non-integer payloads and verify rejection
Send uint64 overflow values and confirm graceful rejection
Verify no panic/crash on malformed RLP-encoded block number requests
checklist.notes: Boundary Guard check. Source: PROP-W0-EIP7639-PRECOND-001. Boundary edge EDGE-RECV-TO-CHECK from EXT-P2P-PEER-ETH70 to EL devp2p eth/70 Block Data Request Handler. Security assumption: all incoming P2P requests must be validated for block number range.

checklist.title: Verify request state initialization sanitizes untrusted P2P data at STATE-REQUEST-RECEIVED
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Trace the state transition into STATE-REQUEST-RECEIVED and confirm that all fields from the P2P message are treated as untrusted. 2. Verify that no downstream logic uses raw request data before validation completes. 3. Check that the state object does not store unsanitized values that could be consumed by later processing stages.
executable_checks: Inspect state object at STATE-REQUEST-RECEIVED for raw untrusted field storage
Verify no TOCTOU between receive and validation
checklist.notes: Supporting node check for boundary property PROP-W0-EIP7639-PRECOND-001. Node STATE-REQUEST-RECEIVED is the first internal state after boundary crossing.

checklist.title: Falsify post-condition: attempt to prevent data serving for valid post-PoS requests
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Submit a valid block data request for block >= 15,537,393 that passes all validation. 2. Verify that ACTION-SERVE-DATA is reached and block data is returned to the requesting peer. 3. Attempt to create conditions where a valid post-PoS request is silently dropped or errors out (e.g., concurrent state changes, resource exhaustion at serve time). 4. Confirm that the post-condition holds: valid requests always result in data being served.
executable_checks: Request block 15537393 and verify data is served
Request latest block and verify data is served
Simulate partial resource exhaustion and verify graceful handling
checklist.notes: Formal Verification Engineer check. Post-condition falsification for PROP-W0-EIP7639-POSTCOND-001. Primary element: ACTION-SERVE-DATA. Covers edges EDGE-POSTPOS-TO-SERVE, EDGE-SERVE-TO-STATE.

checklist.title: Falsify pre-condition: bypass rejection mechanism for pre-PoS requests
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Send requests for blocks < 15,537,393 and verify ACTION-REJECT-REQUEST is triggered. 2. Attempt to bypass the rejection by sending edge-case block numbers (0, 1, 15537392). 3. If rejection is silent drop, verify no partial data leaks. If explicit error, verify error format. 4. Related to AMB-EIP7639-01: check whether the ambiguity in rejection mechanism creates exploitable inconsistency.
executable_checks: Request block 0 and verify rejection
Request block 15537392 (boundary-1) and verify rejection
Verify no data leakage on rejected requests
checklist.notes: Formal Verification Engineer check. Pre-condition falsification for PROP-W0-EIP7639-PRECOND-005. Related ambiguity: AMB-EIP7639-01.

checklist.title: Falsify post-condition: attempt to process out-of-scope messages beyond marking
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Send a message for block < 15,537,393 and verify it transitions to STATE-MSG-OUT-OF-SCOPE. 2. Verify that once in this state, no further processing occurs on the message. 3. Check for race conditions where a message marked out-of-scope could still be partially processed by a concurrent handler.
executable_checks: Verify state is terminal after out-of-scope marking
Check no side effects from out-of-scope messages
checklist.notes: Formal Verification Engineer check. Post-condition falsification for PROP-W0-EIP7639-POSTCOND-005. Primary element: STATE-MSG-OUT-OF-SCOPE.

checklist.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for EDGE-INIT-BOOTSTRAP: checkpoint root origin verification
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Provide a bootstrap request with a checkpoint root from an untrusted source. 2. Verify the light client bootstrap initialization interface validates the checkpoint root cryptographically against the bootstrap object. 3. Attempt to supply a valid-looking but incorrect checkpoint root and verify it is rejected. 4. Verify no authentication of EXT-CHECKPOINT-PROVIDER itself is relied upon (per security assumption). 5. Test with corrupted bootstrap objects that do not match the checkpoint root.
executable_checks: Supply incorrect checkpoint root and verify bootstrap rejection
Supply valid checkpoint root with tampered bootstrap object and verify rejection
Verify no unauthenticated provider data is trusted without cryptographic verification
checklist.notes: Boundary Guard check. Source: PROP-W0-LC-PRECOND-001. Boundary edge EDGE-INIT-BOOTSTRAP from EXT-CHECKPOINT-PROVIDER to CL light client bootstrap. Related assumption: ASSUM-LIGHTCLIENT-03 (weak subjectivity).

checklist.title: Verify bootstrap action validates checkpoint data after boundary crossing
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Trace ACTION-BOOTSTRAP-LC to confirm it performs cryptographic verification of the bootstrap object against the checkpoint root. 2. Verify the bootstrap does not proceed if verification fails. 3. Confirm STATE-LC-UNINITIALIZED does not transition without successful verification.
executable_checks: Verify bootstrap action checks Merkle proof of bootstrap object
Confirm no state transition on verification failure
checklist.notes: Supporting node check for boundary property PROP-W0-LC-PRECOND-001. Nodes: STATE-LC-UNINITIALIZED, ACTION-BOOTSTRAP-LC.

checklist.title: Falsify post-condition: attempt to regress finalized header slot via LightClientUpdate
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Process a valid LightClientUpdate that advances the finalized header. 2. Then submit another valid-looking LightClientUpdate with a finalized header at a lower slot. 3. Verify the second update is rejected and the finalized header slot does not regress. 4. Test with updates at the exact same slot to verify >= semantics. 5. Check for integer underflow in slot comparison logic.
executable_checks: Process update A (slot N), then update B (slot N-1), verify B rejected
Process update at same slot and verify acceptance (>= semantics)
Test with slot=0 after non-zero finalized header
checklist.notes: Formal Verification Engineer check. Post-condition falsification for PROP-W0-LC-POSTCOND-002. Primary element: ACTION-PROCESS-LC-UPDATE.

Verify fork boundary is inclusive (>=)

Verify bomb component at fake_block=300000 equals 2^1 = 2

Call with excessively long method strings. 4. Call with method names that could trigger internal methods or RPC methods that should be restricted. 5. Verify input sanitization prevents injection of special characters in params.
